collection.title: Porsche Cayman 2016 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Porsche Cayman 2016 Onwards (718) will fit, this model requires a 21" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 23" for the passengers side. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
